scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Pure strict-order random poset over individually named finite chains; pairwise existential incomparability only. The proof yields an exact all-size integral congruence and primitive kernel, supported by independent finite integer checks. The type-interval identification and the existence of the random poset are background. Historical equivalence under alternative interval-matrix terminology cannot be excluded; independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Integral hyperbolic decomposition of random-poset type incomparability over named chains
